items.title: Consumer Discretionary Stocks Q2 Recap: Benchmarking Sysco (NYSE:SYY)

items.title: Sysco (SYY): Buy, Sell, or Hold Post Q2 Earnings?
items.summary: Sysco currently trades at $78.11 per share and has shown little upside over the past six months, posting a small loss of 4.3%. The stock also fell short of the S&P 500’s 16.2% gain during that period.

items.title: Sysco (SYY) Plans $1 Billion Common Stock Offering
items.summary: Sysco (NYSE:SYY) announced a US$1b common stock offering to finance its planned acquisition of Jetro Restaurant Depot. The equity raise is scheduled to close ahead of the Jetro Restaurant Depot deal and is not contingent on the transaction completing. Management said proceeds from the US$1b stock sale will be used primarily to support the Jetro Restaurant Depot purchase and related costs.
